_meta.title: Amazon Associates compliance register
_meta.scope: Clauses that constrain what an affiliate automation platform may do, quoted or closely paraphrased from the official Program Documents. Every row cites the official page it came from.
_meta.agreement_version: Associates Program Operating Agreement — updated October 15, 2025

required_blocks.caption: Mandatory on-site text (must appear before publication)

rows.text: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
rows.where: On your Site or any other location where Amazon authorises display or use of Program Content; "clearly and prominently"
rows.note: Missing it is deemed a material breach (OA SS6).

rows.block: Content disclaimer (when Program Content text is displayed)
rows.text: CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS [IN THIS APPLICATION or ON THIS SITE, as applicable] COMES FROM AMAZON. THIS CONTENT IS PROVIDED 'AS IS' AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE OR REMOVAL AT ANY TIME.
rows.where: In plain view to end users of the application/site
rows.note: Square-bracketed choice is selected per context; this site uses "ON THIS SITE".

rows.text: Product prices and availability are accurate as of the date/time indicated and are subject to change. Any price and availability information displayed on [relevant Amazon Site(s), as applicable] at the time of purchase will apply to the purchase of this product.
rows.where: Adjacent to the pricing or availability data, or via hyperlink, pop-up box, scripted pop-up or similar method
rows.note: Required whenever prices come from Data Feeds or are refreshed less often than hourly. Not shown on this site because no price is displayed.

rows.text: e.g. Amazon.com Price: $ 32.77 (as of 01/07/2008 14:11 PST- Details)
rows.where: Adjacent to any displayed price or availability
rows.note: Amazon's own accepted example format. Same-day display may omit the date portion.

rows.text: A clear and conspicuous disclosure of the affiliate relationship, placed with the endorsement
rows.where: Every endorsement, not just some — "if a disclosure is needed in one post for a brand, it's probably needed in all posts"
rows.note: Separate obligation from Amazon's own line. FTC also warns each undisclosed endorsement "could be deceptive".

prohibitions.caption: Prohibited automation behaviours — enforced in this platform's design

rows.prohibition: Price tracking and/or price alerting functionality on your Site (unless otherwise agreed by Amazon)
rows.impl: No alerts, no subscription forms, no price-history charts. Price is only ever a labelled point-in-time value.

rows.prohibition: Using a link shortening service / any placement that makes it unclear you are linking to Amazon
rows.impl: Generated content emits full `amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=<tag>` links. The submitted `link.amazon/...` format was rejected for this reason.

rows.prohibition: Cloaking, hiding, spoofing or otherwise obscuring the URL; Redirecting Links
rows.impl: No redirect wrapper, no intermediate click-handler page; links are direct and static.

rows.prohibition: Artificially generating clicks or impressions, or creating Sessions on an Amazon Site, "whether by way of a robot or software program or otherwise"
rows.impl: The agent has no click-through capability. Preview/health checks use a HEAD probe of `/dp/<ASIN>` only and never register a session-bearing link.

rows.prohibition: Framing an Amazon Site within your Site, including in an embedded browser/WebView
rows.impl: No iframes, no embeds of amazon.com. Product cards are native HTML.

rows.prohibition: Special Links inside pop-up / pop-under windows, transitional page ads or layer ads
rows.impl: No modal ad slots. The disclosure banner is not an ad slot and contains no link.

rows.prohibition: Special Links in content placed on an Amazon Site (reviews, forums, Wish Lists, guides) or links to your Site from Amazon
rows.impl: Publishing targets owned properties only. No Amazon-side posting module exists.

rows.prohibition: Bidding on paid search keywords containing "amazon", "kindle" or any Amazon Mark, or misspellings (e.g. "ammazon", "amaozn", "kindel")
rows.impl: The campaign module blocks Amazon-Mark keywords in its bid-keyword list at validation time; purchases through such ads are disqualified.

rows.prohibition: Displaying Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless the link to that review/rating was obtained through Creators API or PA API
rows.impl: Review text is never stored or rendered. Only an API-sourced count/rating, if credentials exist, would be displayed with attribution.

rows.prohibition: Purchasing products through your own Special Links, or having friends/relatives/employees/contractors do so; resale use
rows.impl: Self-purchase is out of scope for test fixtures; the test harness never constructs a live order.

rows.prohibition: Offering any incentive, reward or rebate for using Special Links (including loyalty/rewards schemes)
rows.impl: No gamification, cashback, giveaway or coupon tied to link use.

rows.prohibition: Storing or caching Product Advertising Content images at all; other content for more than 24 hours; client apps storing any
rows.impl: No image download step in the pipeline — only the image URL is referenced, re-fetched, and TTL-capped at 24h. ASINs may be stored indefinitely.

rows.prohibition: Exceeding call-rate limits or sending payloads >40KB to Creators API / PA API without written approval
rows.impl: Intake client caps request bodies at 40960 bytes and rate-limits per Specifications.

rows.prohibition: Reverse engineering, deriving models/weights from, or bypassing security of Creators API, PA API or Data Feeds
rows.impl: No distillation of API responses into a trained model; API data is used only to render pages.

rows.prohibition: Using Program Content to advertise or promote products offered on non-Amazon sites; using data relating to Excluded Products
rows.impl: Comparison tables may only contain Amazon-sourced rows. Competing-retailer price columns are deliberately absent, despite being standard affiliate practice.

rows.prohibition: Encouraging customers to bookmark your Special Links
rows.impl: No 'save this deal link' prompts anywhere in generated copy.

rows.prohibition: Leaving expired promotional claims on the site (e.g. a "15% off apparel" mention after the promotion ends)
rows.impl: Every claim carrying a promotion is stored with an expiry date; the publisher skips expired blocks.

rows.prohibition: Inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about a Product, an Amazon Site, or Amazon's policies, promotions or prices
rows.impl: Generated claims must cite an API field or a spec sheet; the reviewer flags ungrounded superlatives. Amazon's own example: do not describe a 64 GB phone as 128 GB.

rows.prohibition: Intercepting, recording or redirecting material submitted to Amazon; collecting customer account information
rows.impl: No form proxying, no credential capture, no Amazon-session cookies touched.

rows.prohibition: Modifying, redirecting, suppressing or substituting the operation of any Amazon Site button, link or feature
rows.impl: No browser extension or script injection against Amazon pages.

rows.prohibition: Handling customer service contacts about Amazon orders; Amazon customers are not your customers
rows.impl: Contact flows answer "how do I find my order?" with a pointer to Amazon's own help directions, nothing more.

rows.prohibition: Implying Amazon supports, sponsors or endorses you, or misrepresenting the relationship
rows.impl: Site copy never uses an Amazon logo, and no 'officially recommended by Amazon' phrasing is permitted in generated content.

rows.prohibition: Site content that is hateful, harassing, sexual, violent, deceptive/defamatory, discriminatory, or directed at children under 13
rows.impl: Suitability screen runs per page; the child-directed test also disables any under-13 audience targeting.

rows.prohibition: Putting an Amazon trademark/misspelling in your domain, subdomain, tag, username or group name
rows.impl: Validator rejects any registered hostname or tag containing an Amazon Mark. This site is `Zone3` on github.io — clean.

rows.prohibition: Claiming commissions on the same traffic via another programme (combining/manipulating attribution links)
rows.impl: One traffic source, one attribution chain; no stacked double-attribution links.

economics.caption: Programme mechanics that drive the revenue model

columns.label: What it means for the optimiser

rows.value: "Earn up to 10% in associate commissions from qualifying purchases and programs"
rows.implication: Revenue model must be volume/traffic-led: at <=10% of qualifying revenue, click-through rate and content coverage dominate over per-unit margin.
Not publicly retrievable (redirects to sign-in). Niche ranking by category rate is therefore not computed on this site.

rows.value: Session begins at the Special Link click and ends at the first of: 24 hours elapsing, any non-digital Product order, or a click through another associate's link
rows.implication: Last-click wins and a competing associate's link instantly steals the session. Optimise for direct-to-product links and fast pages, not for journeys that detour off-site.

rows.value: Order completed no later than 89 days after the initial click-through
rows.implication: Long consideration cycles (appliances, high-ticket) still convert — supports deep buying guides over impulse-only placements.

rows.value: Commission accrues on the customer's order in that session, not only the linked item
rows.implication: Traffic quality (basket size) matters more than item relevance; but this must never be gamed, as CIS SS2/SS5 disqualify manipulation.

rows.value: Amount Amazon actually receives, less shipping, gift-wrapping, handling, taxes (sales tax, VAT), service charges, credits, rebates, credit-card processing fees and bad debt
rows.implication: Model revenue on net-of-shipping/tax value, not the sticker price. Overstates earnings otherwise.

rows.value: Approximately 60 days after the end of the month in which it was earned
rows.implication: Cash-cycle lag >=2 months; ROI reporting must be monthly-lagged, not real-time.

rows.value: Direct deposit 10 USD; gift card 10 USD minimum / 2000 USD maximum; check 100 USD minimum with 15 USD processing fee
rows.implication: Gift card is the only low-threshold option; check is uneconomic below ~200 USD.

rows.value: Post-termination purchases; any order with a cancellation, return or refund; Prohibited Paid Search Placements; links displayed on a search engine; Redirecting Links; malformed links; unapproved mobile-app links; Bounty-linked products; subscriptions; pre-release/pre-order products
rows.implication: Data hygiene is a revenue control, not a legal nicety: one malformed tag silently zeroes earnings (CIS 2(g)).

rows.value: No substantial activity for at least 3 years allows Amazon to withhold accrued commission income, up to the gift-card payment minimum, on 7 days' notice
rows.implication: Keep the account active; don't park earnings.

rows.value: Commission is rounded per purchase to the nearest local currency unit, so your effective rate may sit slightly above or below the published rate card
rows.implication: Reconcile against reports, not against a hand-calculated rate.

rows.value: Free to join; Amazon has authorised no paid set-up or consulting service for associates
rows.implication: Any vendor charging for 'Amazon affiliate account set-up' is unauthorised by Amazon's own statement.
